_comment: The canonical permission text. This file is duplicated BYTE-IDENTICALLY in
(src/plugins/__fixtures__/), and a test in each repo asserts its own copy of
Why it matters more than most shared data: this is the text on the screen
where a user decides what to trust a plugin with. Two different sentences
describing one permission is worse than none — whichever the reader saw last
is the one they believe they agreed to, and if the two disagree at all, one
of them is a lie told at the exact moment trust is being established.
Change it in one place and both suites fail until the other is updated.

scene:read.label: Read your layers
scene:read.detail: See the names, structure and properties of layers in your composition.

scene:write.label: Modify your layers
scene:write.detail: Create, change and delete layers. Every change is undoable.

animation:read.label: Read your animation
animation:read.detail: See keyframes and sample animated values over time.

animation:write.label: Modify your animation
animation:write.detail: Create and change keyframes and expressions. Every change is undoable.

assets:read.label: Read images in your project
assets:read.detail: Read the pixels of images already in your composition. Plugins have no network access unless you also grant "Contact specific websites".

net:fetch.label: Contact specific websites
net:fetch.detail: Send and receive data from the websites this plugin lists below — and only those. Combined with permission to read your layers, a plugin could copy your project to them.

assets:write.label: Add images to your project
assets:write.detail: Create new images and place them as layers. Every change is undoable.

timeline.label: Control the playhead
timeline.detail: Read the current time and move the playhead.
